authorization_reference: User-authorized single RTX5090. One fixed capacity=true q1 identical-policy first/second pair on the same frozen H128 input. The prior completed A/A runtime cache is copied into two independent private per-cell runtime caches under the common nonblocking lock before either measurement; default cache remains for offline model resolution. This checks whether early output curves, cache writes and full-request metrics converge under identical warm seeds. One pair is descriptive, not statistical confirmation. No parameter scan, no retries. 900s/cell, 3200s/group, 90GiB cgroup and 2GiB system free after cache copies.
measurement_scope: New physical RTX5090 GPU and lock binding after user-provided endpoint change. Interpret this pair only within this GPU; old cold-cache versus new warm-cache differences cannot identify a cache intervention effect.
